parameters.query:
WITH approve AS (
  UPDATE emma_approvals SET status = CASE WHEN $1 = 'ok' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END, decided_at = now()
  WHERE $1 IN ('ok', 'nein') AND id = $2 AND status = 'pending' RETURNING id
), done AS (
  UPDATE emma_tasks SET status = 'done', done_at = now()
  WHERE $1 = 'erledigt' AND id = $2 AND status = 'open' RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1 AS command,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM approve) + (SELECT count(*) FROM done) AS changed,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.id), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, topic FROM emma_agenda WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) a) AS agenda,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.id), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, left(title, 80) AS title FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) t) AS tasks,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(p ORDER BY p.id), '[]') FROM (SELECT id, engine, left(reason, 80) AS reason FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) p) AS approvals;

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT input, output, created_at FROM interaction_memory
     WHERE user_id = $1 AND output IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6) c) AS recent_chat,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT category, content FROM emma_memory ORDER BY importance DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 15) m) AS memory,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, topic, reason FROM emma_agenda WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 5) a) AS agenda,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending') AS approvals_pending,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open') AS tasks_open,
  emma_budget_spent() AS spent_month;
